name: Image → STL
description: Turn a black-and-white image into a 3D-printable relief. Choose whether black or white is the solid colour, extrude it as a plate or a cut-out, and rough the surface up with grain, scratches, pitting, cracks and chewed edges so logos and artwork print gritty rather than machine-clean. Exports a watertight binary STL; nothing is uploaded.
